_comment: ImageName -> what the picture is built from, for /create-image-refs. For an item, ref names the shipped image used as the subject reference and action is the one change made to it.

ChagaGround.action: the powder is coarse, dark rust-brown chaga powder with a few tiny black crust flecks; same bare mound shape, size, placement and loose crumbs, no bowl

ChamomilePlantGrowing.action: the same plant as a living young mound of hair-fine thread-like leaves growing from a ragged oval patch of tilled soil; leaves only, no flowers, no twine

ChamomilePlantMature.action: the same plant as a living flowering plant growing from a small oval patch of tilled soil; feathery leaves at the base, slender branching stems tipped with about a dozen daisy-like flowers, no twine

PlantainPlantGrowing.action: the same plant as a living low flat rosette of broad ribbed leaves growing from a small oval patch of tilled soil; leaves only, no spikes, no twine

PlantainPlantMature.action: the same plant as a living rosette of broad ribbed leaves growing from a small oval patch of tilled soil, with several tall leafless stalks topped by narrow green-brown flower spikes, no twine

DandelionPlantGrowing.action: the same plant as a living low flat rosette of jagged toothed leaves growing from a small oval patch of tilled soil; leaves only, no flowers

DandelionPlantMature.action: the same plant as a living rosette of toothed leaves growing from a small oval patch of tilled soil, with tall leafless stems each topped by one bright yellow flower head and a few closed buds, no twine

RipePuffball.action: the same round puffball, ripe and dried out: dull papery olive-brown skin with cracks, a small ragged hole in the top with a puff of fine brown spore dust rising from it, a light dusting of the powder on the upper skin; same size and placement, no stem, no bowl

MushroomPastyRaw.action: a raw, unbaked half-moon pasty of pale floury dough, twisted rope-crimped seam, one slit vent, two golden chanterelles resting against its lower edge; shape from the vanilla Pasty_Rye sprite, the mushrooms from ChantFresh

MushroomPasty.action: a baked, golden-brown half-moon pasty with a glossy crust and a few darker toasted patches, twisted rope-crimped seam, one slit vent, two golden chanterelles resting against its lower edge; same shape and placement as MushroomPastyRaw

WildBerryPastyRaw.action: a raw, unbaked half-moon pasty of pale floury dough, twisted rope-crimped seam, one slit vent, a few blackcurrants and redcurrants resting against its lower edge; shape from the vanilla Pasty_Rye sprite, the berries from BlackcurrantFresh and RedcurrantFresh

WildBerryPasty.action: a baked, golden-brown half-moon pasty with a glossy crust, rope-crimped seam, one slit vent and a small stain of purple-red berry juice seeping from the seam, a few blackcurrants and redcurrants resting against its lower edge; same shape and placement as WildBerryPastyRaw
